linkedin.text:
🚨 Your AI coding agent has amnesia.

Every time you close the terminal, it forgets what it built. Every new session starts from scratch. You're stuck babysitting one confused assistant that can't remember yesterday's work.

SwarmForge fixes this with persistent multi-agent teams.

✅ One agent writes TDD code, another refactors it, a third writes Gherkin specs
✅ They pass git commits like a relay race and keep context across sessions
✅ All coordination happens through tmux and local handoff files—no cloud orchestration costs

1,765 stars. Built by Uncle Bob Martin in Clojure. Runs entirely on your machine with git worktrees and a handoff daemon.

Your next feature gets specced, coded, refactored, and QA'd by a team that never sleeps and never forgets.

💡 Search GitHub for "unclebob/swarm-forge" and grab the workflow branch that fits your project size.

Have you tried multi-agent workflows yet, or are you still stuck with single-agent amnesia?
